title: Sense and Sensibility
author: Jane Austen
firstLine: The family of Dashwood had long been settled in Sussex.
begins: Chapter I tells how old Mr. Dashwood leaves Norland to his nephew Henry Dashwood, but tied up for Henry's son John and John's small boy. Henry dies within a year, leaving his widow and three daughters only ten thousand pounds.
happens: After Mr. Henry Dashwood dies, his estate goes to his son John, whose wife Fanny takes over Norland and makes his stepmother and half-sisters unwelcome. Mrs. Dashwood, sensible Elinor, romantic Marianne and young Margaret move to Barton Cottage in Devonshire. Elinor loves Edward Ferrars, but he is long engaged to Lucy Steele. Marianne is swept away by the charming Willoughby, who abandons her to marry a rich heiress, Miss Grey. Marianne falls gravely ill at Cleveland, is nursed by Elinor, and learns restraint. Lucy marries Edward's brother Robert, freeing Edward to marry Elinor; Marianne marries Colonel Brandon.
